priority: other Radar leagues with sufficient verified coverage
season_label_policy: Latest four completed source seasons frozen before holdout evaluation.

source_candidates.name: Football-Data.co.uk Sweden
source_candidates.declared_coverage: historical full-time results and closing match odds for worldwide premier divisions, including Sweden
quality_notes: Use outcome columns only after pre-match feature freeze.
Do not treat generic best/average/Pinnacle closing odds as GoldBet.
Opening-to-closing analysis is allowed only for bookmaker/timestamp pairs explicitly present and verifiable in the downloaded schema.
Pinnacle data after 2025-07-23 requires caution due to provider reliability warning; keep that period separately flagged.

source_candidates.name: Football-Data.co.uk Norway
source_candidates.declared_coverage: historical full-time results and closing match odds for Norway
quality_notes: Ham-Kam and HamKam are one source identity and are canonicalized to HamKam before eligibility and features.
The first 930-row build is quarantined because the alias split removed 30 valid 2023 fixtures.
Six promotion/relegation playoff fixtures are excluded.
Use outcome columns only after pre-match feature freeze.
Closing odds are external market benchmarks and never GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

source_candidates.name: Football-Data.co.uk Denmark
source_candidates.declared_coverage: historical full-time results and closing match odds for Denmark
quality_notes: Frozen seasons 2022/2023-2025/2026 use 12 clubs and 32 accepted league matches per club.
Two chronologically subsequent European playoffs are excluded before evaluation.
Outcome columns are joined only after pre-match feature freeze.
Closing odds remain external benchmarks and never GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

market_close_benchmark.rule: Benchmark market closing prices may support CLV/context only under their true bookmaker/source labels; they never substitute GoldBet TRUE OPEN.

intermediate_t30.rule: Never derive T-30 from CLOSE or interpolate absent timestamps.

pre_match_structural.anti_leakage: Features use strictly prior source dates; updates occur only after the complete date batch.
pre_match_structural.result: Elo remains a research baseline from Sweden/Norway; Denmark did not independently establish Elo over its prior. Form/full bundles remain unpromoted; external close remains non-GoldBet.
pre_match_structural.identity_gate: League-format-specific integrity required: 16 teams/240 matches for Sweden-Norway; 12 teams/32 matches per club for Denmark.

quarantine_rules: prospective 2026 snapshots are not multi-season historical evidence
FIRST_SEEN cannot substitute TRUE OPEN in primary MMS tests
non-GoldBet bookmaker odds cannot be relabelled GoldBet
single-fixture proofs cannot support threshold promotion
sources without unambiguous fixture identity or timestamps are excluded
post-kickoff facts are outcome/evaluation data only

acceptance_gate.structural_rule: Only prior source dates may enter rolling features because source timezone is not documented.
acceptance_gate.market_rule: AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA are closing odds under the provider's documented C-column semantics; retain external benchmark class.
acceptance_gate.primary_mms_reason: No GoldBet TRUE OPEN or same-book OPEN series exists.

next_source_block.goal: Acquire and profile the latest four completed Eredivisie seasons, reconcile identities and format, then apply the frozen research specification without tuning prior holdouts.
